title: Pura’s Cyber Week Sale Is the Time to Stock Up on Scents
gist: A promotional WIRED deals post on Pura's Cyber Week sale (20 percent off fragrances, 30 percent off diffusers through December 6), noting Pura's 150-plus licensed scents, a razor-and-blades cartridge model priced $14–$21 per refill, and mixed hardware reliability across its Home, Mini, Car and Plus diffusers.

insights.claim: Pura offers more than 150 diffuser fragrances from brands including Anthropologie, Nest, LAFCO, Brooklyn Candle Company and Studio McGee, plus seasonal collaborations such as New York City Ballet Nutcracker scents, a breadth WIRED says no rival approaches.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Brand licensing gives Pura a content moat in smart home fragrance, similar to a platform with third-party catalog.
insights.locator: In fact, no brand even comes close to Pura's sheer breadth

insights.claim: Pura single fragrance cartridges cost $14 to $21 at one-time prices, with lower displayed prices only for recurring subscriptions, and cartridges last about a month in the Mini but only a couple of weeks in the larger Plus.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: A razor-and-blades consumables model with subscription nudging drives recurring revenue per device.
insights.locator: But, it's a luxury you'll pay for.

insights.claim: Pura's Cyber Week sale through December 6 cuts fragrances 20 percent and diffusers 30 percent, with the Pura Home at $35 from $50 and a $175 Advent calendar bundle.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Deep hardware discounts are used to grow the installed base that buys recurring cartridges.

insights.claim: WIRED recommends the redesigned Pura Home for its dual-band Wi-Fi, faster and silent diffusion, on-device buttons and QR-coded cartridges that tell the app when to replace them, but does not recommend the Pura Plus after two units developed loud buzzing.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Uneven hardware reliability is a weakness in an otherwise strong consumables franchise; replacements under warranty add cost.
insights.locator: If you're in the market for a Pura diffuser
